capabilities: hide vault windows to the system tray instead of quitting
restore hidden windows by clicking the tray icon
show, hide, or quit Obsidian from the tray icon menu
add hide and quit commands to the command palette
keep the vault loaded so plugins, sync, and CLI commands keep working
extras: Relies on Obsidian internals (is-closing/is-quitting IPC channels and the window-close timer), so it may break on Obsidian updates; verified only on Windows against Obsidian 1.14.4, with macOS and Linux untested. Includes manual installation instructions.
problem: Closing Obsidian's window quits the app, which stops plugins, sync, and command line interface commands from running in the background.
summary: Desktop plugin that keeps Obsidian running in the system tray when its window is closed, so the CLI and background tasks keep working.
